name: Crystal Tide Observatory
description: An observatory perched on a cliff where the tide crashes into crystal formations that sing with light.
prompt: A cliffside observatory with a domed roof. Below, the ocean tide crashes into massive crystal formations that emit musical tones of light with each impact. Night sky full of stars, bioluminescent spray. Ultra‑detail, 8k.
caption: Where waves play crystal symphonies. 🌊🎶
